new_proposals.description: This is the BD-Difco/Bacto yeast nitrogen base family without amino acids, before separate glucose, amino-acid or agar supplementation. NBRC114 and NBRC111 each explicitly name Bacto-Yeast Nitrogen Base w/o Amino acids (Difco),6.7g, but their receiving amino-acid supplements differ. NBRC1402 prints Bactp-Yeast Nitrogen Base w/o Amino Acids,6.7g, with glucose/water/agar only; Bactp is interpreted as a typographical brand variant by the otherwise matching product name, exclusion qualifier and dose, without assigning an unstated historical SKU. The current official BD291940 title corroborates the without-amino-acids product family, but neither its catalogue number nor a particular historical manufacturing lot is assigned to these source recipes. This family excludes complete YNB and the distinct formulation lacking both amino acids and ammonium sulfate. No full chemical composition, invariant lot, whole receiving medium or role is asserted. Raw source labels Bactp-Yeast Nitrogen Base w/o Amino Acids and Bacto-Yeast Nitrogen Base w/o Amino acids (Difco) remain occurrence provenance, not global resolving synonyms.

new_proposals.description: Roscoff PCR-S11 protocol2019 (DOI10.17504/protocols.io.sz3ef8n), section4, defines this Gaffron+Se stock by adding the15listed solutes to500ml water then making a final1L, refrigerated. The payload transcribes the printed mg/L column, not recalculated rounded micromolar values. Actual PDF pages4–5 confirm cadmium nitrate Cd(NO3)2·4H2O and potassium aluminium sulfate KAl(SO4)2·12H2O; these are not guesses from TOGO malformed Cd(NO3).4H2O and KAI(SO4)2.12H2O. Raw TOGO text remains unchanged in evidence. The protocol prints5.16mg/L ammonium molybdate tetrahydrate and1.5mg/L vanadyl sulfate pentahydrate, with footnotes4.94 and1.52 respectively for the original recipe. Its receiving medium uses0.1ml/L and states this gives twice the original PCR-S11 Gaffron level. TOGO M2262 instead records0.5ml/L and a stock table roughly tenfold lower (for example H3BO3 300uM versus this protocol3008.25uM; Ni salt3uM versus30uM). These versions and inconsistent source-dose context are not collapsed. The frozen0.5G_PER_L is also a volume/unit error. This concrete2019stock is a version-qualified related preparation proposal, not automatic identity or composition assignment to the frozen M2262 occurrence. Raw Trace metals Gaffron+Se is not a global alias. All child references remain UNMAPPED, and no complete-medium release is implied. Protocol section6 states that added nutrients have been autoclaved except vitamins; the listed Gaffron+Se nutrient stock is therefore autoclaved before receiving-medium addition. No temperature or duration is supplied or invented.
